purpose: Test whether HMRA Growth × Inflation states map to stable cross-asset payoffs across nearly a century, and whether that mapping changes with absolute inflation / monetary era, before any portfolio-policy evaluation.
hard_rules: Do not alter HMRA-v0.1 sources, 5-year normalization, 70/30 score weights, tanh scaling, or +/-10 thresholds after Phase 2 outcomes are viewed.
Do not use ETFs anywhere in Phase 2.
Damodaran is the primary 1928-2025 asset-outcome source. JST is an independent equity/bond cross-check only.
Same-year state_t vs return_t is descriptive structural evidence, never a causal or tradable claim.
Strict-causal primary mapping is state_t -> full-calendar-year return_t+2 exactly as frozen in Phase 1.
Gold observations before the post-Bretton-Woods investability boundary may be reported as monetary-history context but cannot support a modern investable-gold allocation claim.
Do not tune era boundaries, absolute-inflation cutoffs, minimum sample sizes, or statistical procedures based on asset results.
Phase 2 stops at asset/payoff structure and causal information. It must not optimize or run the #89 allocation matrix.

parser_policy: Use the first annual-return columns listed above, not cumulative-value columns with duplicate labels/suffixes.
Convert percent strings to decimal annual returns.
Fail closed on duplicate year, missing required primary asset column, or nonnumeric annual return after percent parsing.
Do not silently refresh the source if the raw SHA differs from the Phase 0 frozen SHA.

independent_cross_check.role: Independent equity/bond directional and state-payoff robustness check; not a source-selection alternative.
restrictions: Do not choose between Damodaran and JST based on which produces the preferred conclusion.
JST cross-check must be reported as agreement/disagreement with primary evidence.
JST bill_rate is not assumed identical to Damodaran T-bill total return and is not used in the primary Treasury-minus-cash spread.

units.equity: decimal nominal total return; official definition r[t] = ((p[t] + d[t]) / p[t-1]) - 1
units.treasury: decimal nominal total return; official definition r[t] = ((p[t] + coupon[t]) / p[t-1]) - 1
units.cash_rate: decimal nominal bill return/rate as documented; not used for primary Treasury-minus-cash spread

independent_cross_check.unit_policy: Use JST eq_tr and bond_tr as stored decimal returns. Do not divide by 100 or infer scale from realized values.

primary_spreads.name: equity_minus_treasury
primary_spreads.meaning: relative preference for equity versus long government bonds

primary_spreads.name: treasury_minus_cash
primary_spreads.meaning: duration excess return versus short bills

primary_spreads.name: equity_minus_gold
primary_spreads.meaning: equity versus gold; investability interpretation restricted before gold boundary

primary_spreads.name: treasury_minus_gold
primary_spreads.meaning: Treasury versus gold; investability interpretation restricted before gold boundary

derived_payoffs.asset_leader_definition: Highest arithmetic annual return among the assets eligible for the relevant comparison window. Pre-gold-investability leader tests use equity/treasury/cash only; gold-valid leader tests may include gold.

structural_context.role: monetary-history context only; not modern investable-allocation evidence
floating-price transition context; still not primary investable-gold allocation evidence
primary gold-valid structural / later portfolio window

gold_boundary.phase2_use: All-year gold spreads may be shown with boundary labels, but any statement about investable gold robustness must use 1975+ primary evidence.

strict_causal_primary.causal_claim: information-timing-safe predictive association, not proof of economic causality

bootstrap.method: nonparametric percentile bootstrap of annual observations within the cell/group

small_sample_labels.n_lt_3: insufficient; no mean CI or directional conclusion
small_sample_labels.n_5_to_9: sparse; eligible for sign diagnostics but weak

cell_level_primary: For each HMRA 3x3 cell, report primary spreads in the full sample.
For each predeclared historical era with n>=3 in the cell, report era-specific spread means and signs.
Report sign_consistency = share of eligible eras whose mean spread has the same nonzero sign as the full-sample cell mean.
Report leader_consistency separately for eligible asset sets where n>=3.
regime_stability_tests.no_winner_ranking_rule: Do not rank cells, eras, or asset mappings by a composite score.

absolute_inflation_regime_test.cell_eligibility: Both background groups must have n>=5 within the same HMRA cell.
absolute_inflation_regime_test.primary_comparison: Difference in mean spread: at_or_above_4pct minus below_4pct.
absolute_inflation_regime_test.interpretation: Evidence for a higher-order inflation regime is descriptive if the same HMRA cell shows a material sign reversal or a bootstrap CI for the spread difference excluding zero; do not convert this to a tuned third-axis allocation rule in Phase 2.

primary_metrics: full-sample mean spread by HMRA cell
sign of full-sample mean spread by HMRA cell
leave_one_era_out.procedure: For each predeclared era, remove all observations in that era and recompute cell-level spread means/signs.
leave_one_era_out.interpretation: A mapping is era-concentrated if its full-sample sign changes after omitting one eligible era or if more than half of the absolute full-sample mean disappears after one era removal.

cross_source_validation.primary_overlap: 1928-2020 where both sources have usable U.S. equity and government-bond total returns
report: overall annual-return correlation between primary and JST equity series
overall annual-return correlation between primary and JST bond series
cell-level sign agreement of mean equity_minus_treasury for HMRA cells with n>=5 in both sources
cross_source_validation.interpretation: Disagreement is evidence uncertainty and must be reported; it cannot be resolved by selecting the source with preferred results.

multiple_testing_and_interpretation.inferential_status: exploratory structural validation on reused historical data; not untouched OOS
multiple_testing_and_interpretation.p_values: not primary; no fishing across significance thresholds
multiple_testing_and_interpretation.bootstrap_ci_role: uncertainty descriptor, not a binary production gate

verdict_rules.structurally_stable_mapping: Broad sign/leader consistency across eras, no systematic absolute-inflation sign reversal, leave-one-era-out robustness, and meaningful agreement in strict-causal/cross-source checks.
verdict_rules.inflation_regime_dependent_mapping: At least one economically central HMRA cell shows repeatable/payoff sign differences between <4% and >=4% absolute-inflation backgrounds, with broader evidence that inflation background explains mapping instability better than one isolated era.
verdict_rules.monetary_regime_dependent_mapping: Mapping changes align materially with predeclared historical monetary eras beyond what the simple <4%/>=4% inflation split captures.
verdict_rules.asset_mapping_unstable: Material cell-level signs/leaders change across eras without coherent higher-order inflation/monetary structure, or leave-one-era-out/cross-source evidence is broadly unstable.
verdict_rules.inconclusive_long_history_evidence: Sparse cells, conflicting sources, or mixed diagnostics prevent a defensible structural classification.

explicit_non_goals: Do not evaluate the #89 3x3 allocation matrix in Phase 2.
Do not promote a production allocator.
Do not infer that same-year associations are causal.
